prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1296; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you disclose the full liability limits of the policy issued to the at-fault driver, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please provide this information in writing as soon as possible.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this claim. This includes photographs, vehicle data, dash camera footage, telematics records, witness statements, adjuster notes, and any recorded communications. Please take steps to ensure none of this material is altered, discarded, or lost while the matter is pending.

We look forward to your prompt response.
